response.justification: Although Bogdan is a highly experienced full-stack engineer and open-source contributor with solid mentoring and distributed systems experience, he lacks the core technical foundation required for this role. The position explicitly mandates 8 years of C++ programming and deep experience with cloud compute platforms and infrastructure, whereas Bogdan's background is predominantly in TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang for web applications, with less than a year of professional C++ experience.
strengths: Demonstrated technical leadership and mentoring through Staff-level roles, workshops, and coding dojos.
Experience building distributed systems and handling high-throughput microservices (e.g., millions of HTTP requests/second at Dunnhumby).
Strong software design and testing background, including TDD, CI/CD implementations, and open-source test library development.
concerns: Significantly falls short of the 8 years of C++ experience required, possessing only about 7 months of professional C++ experience from 2014-2015.
Background is heavily focused on full-stack web and product development rather than foundational cloud compute platforms and hardware architecture.
Lacks extensive, long-term experience managing lower-level cloud infrastructure and compute technologies.
